title: Udaan - Talent Management
description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

About Udaan 3.0

  

Udaan is Myntra’s initiative specifically designed to offer a career launchpad to people with disabilities. It is a six month paid employment opportunity that ensures a conducive environment facilitating a smooth transition to work. With structured on-boarding, customized learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, on the job learning and best in class benefits, we aim to provide an environment that is supportive, so that you can thrive and build your career with us.

As a part of our commitment towards diversity and inclusion, through this program, we strive to create a culture where all can belong and bring their experiences and authentic selves to work every day. During your internship with us, you will get the opportunity to work with the best talent in the e-commerce industry and work on projects that match your interest, abilities and could lead to full-time employment with Myntra.

**About Team**

We are seeking an execution‑focused Associate – Talent Management to support the design, delivery, and adoption of talent initiatives. This role will work closely with HRBPs and the Talent Management team to drive program execution, monitor adoption metrics, and provide insights that strengthen employee development and career progression.

The role requires strong operational discipline, stakeholder coordination, and analytical capability to ensure smooth execution of talent processes.

Roles & Responsibilities

  
**- Employee Engagement Support**  

* Organize engagement activities tied to talent initiatives.
* Coordinate awareness sessions, manager enablement workshops, and skill‑based campaigns.

**- Process Documentation**  

* Maintain clear documentation of workflows, guidelines, and FAQs.
* Ensure employees and managers can easily navigate systems like the Talent Marketplace.

**- Stakeholder Communication**  

* Draft communication materials, reminders, and status updates.
* Keep HRBPs and business leaders aligned on adoption progress and program timelines.

**- Program Support**  

* Assist in execution of talent initiatives in partnership with HRBPs and COEs.
* Provide operational support for program rollouts and awareness campaigns.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of deliverables.

**- Talent Marketplace Adoption**  

* Support awareness and adoption of the internal Talent Marketplace platform.
* Track usage metrics (active users, project participation, IDP completion).
* Identify barriers to adoption and recommend improvement actions.
* Assist in building communication materials and toolkits to enable employees and managers.

**- Skills Framework Activation**  

* Support embedding of skills into hiring, development conversations, and performance management.
* Track skill data trends and identify gaps across functions.
* Assist in creating enablement materials for career conversations.

**- Career Architecture & Development**  

* Help develop communication guides that simplify career architecture for employees.
* Track IDP completion and quality metrics across business units.
* Identify trends in career movement and highlight skill gaps impacting progression.

**-** **Analytics & Reporting**  

* Prepare periodic reports on talent metrics and adoption trends.
* Support maintenance of Talent dashboards (skills data, IDP completion, attrition trends).

Qualifications & Experience

  

* 6+ months of experience in HR, Talent Management, or related areas.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
* Detail‑oriented with good communication skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast‑paced environment with evolving priorities.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Bangalore, Karnataka
  
Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) to design, develop, deploy, and operationalize machine learning solutions leveraging industrial and enterprise data. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in machine learning model development, time-series analytics, MLOps, and cloud-based data platforms.
  
  
This role will focus on building predictive and prescriptive analytics solutions using operational data from platforms such as AVEVA/OSI PI System, Azure Data Explorer (ADX), Databricks ML, and DataRobot. The candidate will collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Owners, and Business SMEs to deliver scalable AI/ML solutions that drive operational excellence and business value
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Machine Learning Development
  

* Design, develop, train, evaluate, and validate machine learning models for forecasting, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, asset performance optimization, and classification/regression use cases.
* Develop feature engineering, data preparation, and model training pipelines using Python-based ML frameworks.
* Analyze large-scale operational and industrial datasets to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights.
* Perform model tuning, hyperparameter optimization, and performance benchmarking.

Time-Series Analytics
  

* Work extensively with time-series and sensor data sourced from AVEVA PI System (OSI PI) and Azure Data Explorer (ADX).
* Develop forecasting and anomaly detection models for industrial operations.
* Build scalable analytics workflows for high-frequency telemetry and operational data.

MLOps & Model Lifecycle Management
  

* Implement MLOps frameworks and best practices for model deployment, monitoring, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Develop automated model training, testing, validation, and deployment pipelines.
* Monitor model performance, data drift, and model drift in production environments.
* Support model retraining and continuous improvement processes.

Skill Requirements
  
  

* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or related discipline.
* 4–8 years of hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions.
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
* Hands-on experience with DataRobot and Databricks Machine Learning.
* Experience with AVEVA PI System (OSI PI) and Azure Data Explorer (ADX).
* Strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, feature engineering, model validation, and statistical analysis.
* Experience implementing MLOps practices including model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management.

Other Requirements
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
* Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional
* DataRobot AI Practitioner Certification

description:

**Job Title: Associate – Payroll Control**

**Location: Bangalore, India**

**Role Description**

The Associate, Payroll Control, is responsible for supporting the governance, risk, control, compliance, and oversight framework for payroll operations across assigned countries and entities. The role will partner closely with Payroll Operations, HR, Finance, Tax, Technology, and external vendors to ensure payroll processes are executed accurately, compliantly, and in accordance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your key responsibilities**

**Payroll Controls**

* Execute and maintain payroll processes and control frameworks.
* Review payroll inputs, outputs, reconciliations, exceptions, and approvals to ensure compliance with established controls.
* Support payroll risk assessments and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are implemented.
* Monitor payroll performance metrics and identify opportunities for control enhancements.

**Compliance & Regulatory Management**

* Ensure adherence to statutory, tax, labour, social security, and regulatory requirements.
* Track legislative and regulatory changes impacting payroll operations.
* Support implementation of regulatory changes and compliance initiatives.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence repositories.

**Risk Management & Audit Support**

* Support internal and external payroll audits.
* Coordinate remediation and closure of audit findings.
* Perform periodic control reviews and identify process improvement opportunities.
* Escalate significant risks, control gaps, and compliance issues appropriately.

* Monitor payroll vendor performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs.
* Support governance reviews with payroll providers and third-party partners.
* Assist in issue resolution, root cause analysis, and service improvement initiatives.

title: Associate Engineer - Digital Technology
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.  
  
Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------

Are you a Developer looking for a new technical hands-on role? Do you want to join a growing Software Development team?  
Are you interested in cutting edge technologies, with the ability to collaborate with your fellow software developers?  
Are you thrilled by having an opportunity to fly around the world on employee pass while working on innovative and critical software applications?  
If you answered yes to any of the above, we have an exciting role for you within our Digital Technology practice to enhance and build industry-leading platforms while transforming our customer’s travel journey as a software leader. United’s Digital Technology team designs, develops, and maintains massive-scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architecture, data analytics, and digital solutions.  
United Airlines is growing faster than ever, and we need talented software engineers / developers like you to fill the critical openings across our business. This is a hybrid position with ample flexibility working from home or at the office. Annual base salary/bonus incentives, along with exciting travel opportunities with free flight travel (on employee pass) benefits.

**Our Values**

At United Airlines, we believe that inclusion propels innovation and is the foundation of all that we do. Our Shared Purpose: "Connecting people, Uniting the world" drives us to be the best airline for our employees, customers, and everyone we serve. We can only do that with a truly diverse and inclusive workforce. Our team spans the globe and is made up of diverse individuals all working together with cutting edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation.

With multiple employee-run "Business Resource Group" communities and world-class benefits like health insurance, parental leave, and unlimited space-available travel, United is truly a one-of-a-kind place to work making you feel welcome, accepted, and like you truly belong. Be part of our team and help us make a positive impact on the world. Diverse candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

This role plays an important role in creating and maintaining software solutions supporting United's Airport Operations applications. This role is to develop, design, create and modify software applications/systems to support core business functions. This individual will apply proven technical (best practices and patterns), communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help develop/design/implement software applications/systems to maximize IT's benefit to United Airlines.

* Solve complex performance problems and architectural challenges.
* Participate in code reviews.

* Introduce new technologies and best practices as needed to solve business problems
* Help to troubleshoot, test, and maintain the quality and security of the platform
* Work in an Agile environment
* Strong team player and good communicator

**This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd - a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**

* B.E./B.Tech. in a related technical field, or equivalent experience, education or training.
* 1- 2 Years of experience as Full Stack Developer.
* Strong foundation in programming paradigms and architectural concepts, including object-oriented programming, data structures and algorithms and database systems.

* Familiarity with AWS Services like S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step function, ECS, EKS.

* Experience at component and unit testing of following standard practices and methodologies
* Effective verbal and written communication skills with a strong team-player mindset.
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile methodology.

Your first rotation will be within our Engineering organization, where you will contribute to real business challenges, collaborate with experienced professionals, and help deliver innovative solutions for global customers.
